name: last-call
description: Stops work at a clean point before the 5-hour (or 7-day) usage limit, keeps the prompt cache warm while waiting, and continues the work after the reset.

autoResume.title: Resume automatically
autoResume.description: Continue the work by itself after the reset. Off: wait for /last-call go or your next prompt.

wrapAtPercent.title: 5-hour wrap-up at (%)
wrapAtPercent.description: The 5-hour fill at which the model is told to find a clean stopping point.

stopAtPercent.title: 5-hour stop at (%)
stopAtPercent.description: The 5-hour fill at which every tool but writing the handoff note is refused. The rest is the keep-alive reserve.

sevenDayWrapAtPercent.title: 7-day wrap-up at (%)
sevenDayWrapAtPercent.description: The 7-day fill at which the model is told to find a clean stopping point.

sevenDayStopPercent.title: 7-day stop at (%)
sevenDayStopPercent.description: The 7-day fill at which work stops.

wrapLeadMinutes.title: Wrap-up lead (minutes)
wrapLeadMinutes.description: Also start wrapping up when the burn rate projects the stop within this many minutes.

keepAlive.title: Keep the cache warm
keepAlive.description: While paused, ping the same model with the cached conversation, but only when that costs less than reloading it once.

keepAliveMinutes.title: Keep-alive interval (minutes)
keepAliveMinutes.description: Minutes between keep-alive pings, 5 to 59 (the cache lives 60 minutes).

keepAliveSessions.title: Keep-alive sessions
keepAliveSessions.description: all: every paused session pings its own cache. one: only one session on this machine pings at a time.

handoffPath.title: Handoff note path
handoffPath.description: Where the model writes the handoff note, relative to the project root. Must stay inside the project.

handoffGitIgnored.title: Git-ignore the handoff note
handoffGitIgnored.description: Add the note's path to the repository's local exclude file (.git/info/exclude). No tracked file is changed.

coldResumeDefault.title: Cold resume default
coldResumeDefault.description: When the cache has expired at resume and nobody answers: compact then resume, resume with the full context, or wait.

coldResumeTimeoutMinutes.title: Cold resume timeout (minutes)
coldResumeTimeoutMinutes.description: How long the cold-resume question waits for an answer before the default applies (1 to 120).
